purpose: Test whether the preregistered E002d relative-phase PFL3 population state propagates through the frozen steering scaffold into a correctly lateralized modeled DNa02 turn signal.
selection_rule: Do not alter the primary threshold, phase probes, side groups, model parameters, or controls based on E002e outcome. Threshold 5 remains primary because it was frozen before E002d/E002e from the broad structural-support lane.
claim_boundary: Passing E002e would support a modeled, body-ID-resolved PFL3-to-descending steering transformation under a literature-constrained relative phase representation. It would not establish sensory-to-goal encoding, measured firing, closed-loop odor navigation, or superiority of intact wiring over rewires.
